🚨🇲🇽 MEXICO'S NAVY SEIZES 1.2 TONS OF COCAINE IN CHIAPAS — THE DEMAND LIVES UP NORTH

The Mexican Navy seized 1.2 tons of cocaine in Chiapas on July 1 — 860 kg inland at San José El Hueyate, 384 kg off a speedboat at sea — with 8 arrests and 2.4 million doses kept off the market. Over 74 tons have been seized this administration. Mexico does the interdicting; the guns flow south from North Carolina and the demand never leaves the United States. Shared problem, one-sided lecture.

🇲🇽📊 MEXICO'S 2027 BUDGET: MORE SOCIAL PROGRAMS, NO AUSTERITY

Mexico's 2027 spending plan expands federal programs from 661 to 672 — a 1.6% increase — keeping the architecture of the welfare state intact. No "adjustment," no gutting of social programs, even as ratings agencies and the IMF keep prescribing austerity to the rest of the region. The 4T's answer to uncertainty is to protect what reaches the people, not cut it.

🇲🇽🇻🇪 MEXICO SENDS 71.2 TONS TO EARTHQUAKE-HIT VENEZUELA WHILE WASHINGTON KEEPS SANCTIONING IT

After the June 24 earthquakes, Mexico has delivered 71.2 tons of humanitarian aid to Venezuela — food, 13.1 tons of medicine, and 8 power plants with solar arrays — plus 250 Yumare rescuers who pulled survivors from the rubble and gave 1,411 medical consultations. A Navy ship sails Thursday with more. This is what South-South solidarity looks like: not blockades, not "maximum pressure" — trucks, medics, and lights.

🚨🇲🇽 MICHOACÁN HOMICIDES DOWN 46% — AND THE STATE IS GUARDING ITS LIME AND AVOCADO FARMERS

Michoacán's daily homicide average fell from 4.32 in January 2025 to 2.33 in June 2026 — a 46% drop, the lowest June since 2015. But the real tell is where Sheinbaum's Plan Michoacán put its people: 860 troops guarding lime growers, 820 guarding avocado producers, because extortion of farmers is what bleeds this state. 1,300 arrested for high-impact crimes, 1,400 guns seized. Security as protection of the people who feed the country — not occupation.
